sections: Nelson Lin operates this personal engineering website from Taiwan. This notice covers this website, not external sites you choose to visit.

GitHub Pages delivers this site and processes connection information such as IP addresses for delivery and security under GitHub’s privacy policy. Theme, language, and dismissed language suggestions are stored in your browser until you clear site data. Fonts, icons, and profile images are served locally. Delivery and security serve the legitimate interest of operating the site; preference storage supports your requested settings.

Optional analytics uses your consent. When enabled, Cookiebot records your consent choices, time, consent identifier, and technical connection information. Choices expire after 180 days and can be changed through Privacy settings. Our browser record stores the consent version, time, and category choices. Consent administration supports our compliance obligations. Rejecting optional services does not prevent reading the site. If consent cannot be verified, optional services stay off.

Only after analytics consent, GA4 measures page visits and outbound destination hostnames to help improve the site. Google receives browser/device information and connection data; analytics cookies identify browser sessions. We omit URL queries, fragments, outbound paths, and referrers from our event payloads. We do not send account identifiers or form contents, use advertising personalization, or link Google Ads. Browser analytics cookies last up to 180 days without renewal. User/event retention is configured to two months without activity resets; standard aggregated reports are not subject to that limit.

Comments connect to Giscus and GitHub only after you explicitly allow and load them. That sends your IP address, browser information, and page location to those services. Comment consent is separate from analytics consent. GitHub sign-in and submitted comments follow GitHub’s terms; comments and reactions may be public and persist until deleted through GitHub. External links leave this website and follow the destination’s policy.

Providers include GitHub (hosting and discussions), Google (optional analytics), Usercentrics/Cookiebot (consent management), and Giscus (optional comment display). Providers may process information outside Taiwan, including in the United States and Europe. Applicable processing terms and transfer safeguards must be reviewed before optional services are activated. Consent evidence is retained under Cookiebot’s configured service terms; the 180-day browser preference is not a promise to erase provider logs. Hosting logs and GitHub content follow their respective policies.

Privacy settings lets you withdraw consent as easily as granting it. Withdrawal stops future analytics, clears accessible analytics cookies, and removes embedded comments; it does not automatically erase past data or public GitHub comments. Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or object to processing, and complain to the relevant data protection authority. Contact the operator privately using the email above. We may request proportionate information to verify your request; without a browser identifier we may be unable to locate analytics records. Do not post personal data in public GitHub issues.
This notice and the consent configuration are reviewed when providers or purposes change. Material changes require renewed consent. No advertising is included in this integration.
